# pve_ceph_osd_metadata (Data Source)

Details (devices, versions, locations) of one OSD.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ceph_osd_metadata" "example" {
  node  = "pve1"
  osdid = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `osdid` (Number) OSD ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<osdid>.
- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Read-Only:

- `devices` (Attributes List) Array containing data about devices (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--devices))
- `osd` (Attributes) General information about the OSD (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--osd))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata.devices`

Read-Only:

- `dev_node` (String) Device node
- `device` (String) Kind of OSD device
- `physical_device` (String) Underlying physical device(s) used by this OSD device (comma- or space-joined when multiple).
- `size` (Number) Size of the OSD device in bytes.
- `support_discard` (Boolean) Whether the underlying physical device supports discard/TRIM.
- `type` (String) Type of device. For example, hdd or ssd


<a id="nestedatt--metadata--osd"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata.osd`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (Number) ID of the OSD.
- `back_addr` (String) Address and port used to talk to other OSDs.
- `encrypted` (Boolean) Whether the OSD is encrypted with LUKS via dm-crypt.
- `front_addr` (String) Address and port used to talk to clients and monitors.
- `hb_back_addr` (String) Heartbeat address and port for other OSDs.
- `hb_front_addr` (String) Heartbeat address and port for clients and monitors.
- `hostname` (String) Name of the host containing the OSD.
- `mem_usage` (Number) Proportional set size (PSS) memory usage of the OSD daemon process in bytes; 0 when the process is not running.
- `osd_data` (String) Path to the OSD's data directory.
- `osd_objectstore` (String) The type of object store used.
- `pid` (Number) OSD process ID; absent if the systemd unit for this OSD is not currently running.
- `version` (String) Ceph version of the OSD service.
